Sidebar with tabs

Source: R/widget_sidebar_ui.R
sidebar_tabs.Rd

Create a sidebar with tabs.

Usage

sidebar_tabs(id, icon_list = NULL, ...)

Arguments

id

character identifier for sidebar.

icon_list

list of icon() objects. These icons are shown when the sidebar is collapsed. Not that the list is required and must match the amount of sidebar_pane() objects. Defaults to NULL such that no icons are included.

...

The individual sidebar_pane() objects.

Value

A shiny.tag object.

See also

Other functions for the sidebar widget: acknowledgments_sidebar_pane(), add_sidebar_control(), contact_sidebar_pane(), sidebar_close(), sidebar_disable(), sidebar_enable(), sidebar_open(), sidebar_pane()

Examples

# load packages
library(shiny)
library(htmltools)

# create sidebar panes
p1 <- sidebar_pane(
  id = "pane1", icon = icon("car"),
  tags$div(tags$p("Text"))
)
p2 <- sidebar_pane(
  id = "pane2", icon = icon("star"),
  tags$div(actionButton(inputId = "button", label = "Click me!"))
)

# create sidebar with tabs
sidebar_tabs(
  id = "sidebar",
  icon_list = list(icon("car"), icon("star")),
  p1, p2
)
